modelDescription: It’s time to Pursue Your Legacy. This innovative rifle from Christensen Arms is offered in four distinct, feature-rich models that are intentionally built to tackle any challenge you throw at them. Featuring a proprietary Christensen Arms action  with a 3-lug bolt and 60-degree bolt throw, detachable magazine, hybrid grip angle, premium adjustable trigger, 416R stainless steel suppressor-ready barrel with an RFR-style brake, integrated Picatinny rail, swivel sling studs, and adjustable cheek riser and optic-ready  base on select models; Evoke has it all. Each model was carefully designed with purpose to not just meet, but exceed, the needs of hunters  and shooters of all kinds — and is backed by Christensen Arms’ legendary Sub-MOA Guarantee and Limited Lifetime Warranty. Mossy Oak enthusiasts, meet your new favorite rifle. This model wraps Evoke’s robust features in Mossy Oak Bottomland camouflage, creating a standout rifle that disappears in the backwoods.
